mapper.select: select sa.*,su.username,sf.floor_name from store_address sa left join store_user su on sa.user_id = su.user_id left join store_floor sf on sa.floor_id = sf.floor_id where sa.deleted = 0 and sf.deleted = 0 and su.deleted = 0 and (#{storeAddressQuery.name} is null or sa.name like concat('%',#{storeAddressQuery.name},'%')) and (#{storeAddressQuery.tel} is null or sa.tel like concat('%',#{storeAddressQuery.tel},'%')) and (#{storeAddressQuery.username} is null or su.username like concat('%',#{storeAddressQuery.username},'%')) and (#{storeAddressQuery.floorName} is null or sf.floor_name like concat('%',#{storeAddressQuery.floorName},'%')) and (#{storeAddressQuery.starttime} is null or sa.create_time >= #{storeAddressQuery.starttime}) and (#{storeAddressQuery.endtime} is null or sa.create_time <= #{storeAddressQuery.endtime})
